recordedAtUtcSource: date -u, read from the shell at write time

originalDefect.buildWindowPlan: mapped only the WINDOW_V1_WORK_ITEMS constant and hard-coded the V1 recordId, records, windowName, plannedPrimary 9, the V1 strategy bindings and the genesis-ledger binding
originalDefect.computeWindowPreflight.windowPlanValid: rebuilt any supplied plan through that V1-only builder, so it was necessarily false for any other window
originalDefect.computeWindowPreflight.workItemsMatchFro: compared the plan's items to the WINDOW_V1_WORK_ITEMS constant, not to the current window's precommitted specification

architecture.spec: PrecommittedWindowSpec: planSchema, record identity, window name, generation, governance file bindings, starting ledger revision (path, file sha, bytes, ledgerHash, entryCount), plannedWindowSize, ordered expected work items (kind, workItemId, selectionIndex, reserveRankPosition|null, split, drawEntrySha256, replacementReason|null, replacesOccupant|null), stateAtPlanTime
architecture.specValidation: precommittedWindowSpecViolations: selectionIndex 0..109; canonical P:<i> / R:<i>:<r>; PRIMARY has null reserve and no replacement facts and digests selection[i]; REPLACEMENT digests reserve[r], takes the next unused position after the starting ledger, carries a frozen reason and occupant kind; split = the draw slot's split; no duplicate id, slot or reserve position; size = item count
architecture.planShapes: discriminated: the historical Window V1 plan (no planSchema, singular plannedPrimary) is untouched; later plans carry planSchema PRECOMMITTED_WINDOW_PLAN_GENERIC_V1, plannedPrimarySelectionIndices and plannedReplacementAssignments. No V1 field is reinterpreted.
architecture.builder: buildPrecommittedWindowPlan(draw, spec): a legacy spec renders through the untouched buildWindowPlan; a generic spec renders the versioned plan
architecture.preflight: computePrecommittedWindowPreflight(input with expectedWindowSpec): rebuild-from-spec canonical equality + hash recomputation (windowPlanValid), item projection equals spec items (workItemsMatchFrozenPlan), plus governanceBindingsValid, startingLedgerRevisionMatchesPrecommit (ledger prefix hash, observed file sha, plan binding equals spec binding) and noUnexpectedReplacementAssignments
architecture.legacyEntryPoint: computeWindowPreflight keeps its signature and its ten invariants; it is now the generic preflight against windowV1ExpectedSpec (work items from WINDOW_V1_WORK_ITEMS, digests from WINDOW_V1_DRAW_ENTRY_SHA256 re-proven against the draw)
architecture.windowV2SpecSource: windowSpecFromNextWindowStrategy(strategy record, strategy file facts): fails closed unless the file facts are the landed strategy's and its frame/draw/ledger/state agree

specIndependence.expectedSpecSource: the landed strategy record (52ed4472...), read by windowSpecFromNextWindowStrategy; its signature has no plan parameter
specIndependence.selfHashIsNotSufficient: every plan mutation is tested RESEALED (its own hash recomputed) and still fails windowPlanValid, because the plan must equal the rebuild from the independent spec
specIndependence.selfConsistentWrongPlanRefused: a plan built from a different spec (P:14 -> P:15) recomputes its own hash but fails windowPlanValid and workItemsMatchFrozenPlan

windowV1Compatibility.genericPreflightOnGenesisLedger: only replacementAssignmentsRecorded and currentOccupantsMatch false, as before
windowV1Compatibility.historicalEntryPoint: ten invariants, all green on the current ledger; existing 104 continuation-window tests pass unmodified

genericWindowTests.primaryOnly: PASS: green with zero replacement assignments; P:20 may start

genericWindowTests.allReplacement: PASS: green after three appends; R:10:4 first

windowV2Plan.generatedBy: a one-off offline invocation of the committed pure buildPrecommittedWindowPlan (Commit A) over the verified draw and the strategy-derived spec; rendered with the repository prettier; exclusive create; reread byte-equal; no hand-edited digest

windowV2Preflight.over: the committed plan bytes, reread from disk
